title: Iehoram againe
summary: Iehoram againe is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Iuda, by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only and is not converted to BC.

reign.citation: Raleigh, The History of the World (1617, EEBO-TCP A10357), Chronological Table, sig. 787b
reign.note: Year cell "3795 3113 120". The third printed figure 120 is the column "Temple", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 8 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Iuda..
